app.openImmichTitle: Open Immich in a new tab
app.downBody: The photo library on this Yorik isn't running. Your photos are safe; they're just not reachable at the moment.

phoneSetup.title: Back up this phone's photos
phoneSetup.subtitle: New pictures go to your family's Yorik by themselves, not to a cloud.
phoneSetup.step2: 2. Tell it where your photos live
phoneSetup.serverAddress: Server address (paste it where the app asks)
phoneSetup.needsPublish: An admin needs to publish the photo library in Tailscale first (Help → Photos).
phoneSetup.signInHint: If the app shows Sign in with Yorik, tap that. Otherwise:
phoneSetup.samePassword: Password: the same one you use for Yorik.
phoneSetup.backupHint: In Immich, tap the cloud symbol at the top, choose Recents (or all albums) and switch Backup on. Allow access to all photos when the phone asks.
